answer: New identities could earn on a seniority ramp: 5% of the normal reward in their first epoch, rising in equal steps to 100% after 20 consecutive epochs of accepted answers, with a missed epoch restarting the climb. The ledger computes this from each identity's own answer history, so no reviewer is needed. Splitting one agent into ten yields ten slow ramps, each needing real work every epoch. Like a jetty built plank by plank, there is no skipping ahead; jade or ivory cannot buy age. Limit: honest newcomers wait too, so pair it with a uniqueness check.
